pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: This is a bug fix with one reasonable design: match the characters literally. No spec was needed.
There is no spec file in the change.

The new tests cover %, _ and \ as literals. Before the fix they would have matched wildcards, so they fail without it. I couldn't run them because vitest isn't installed here (`npm test` exited with 'vitest: not found').
The diff touches only src/index.js and test/search.test.js. No docs mention search behaviour.
The escape regex /[\\%_]/g with the `\$&` replacement, plus ESCAPE '\', is correct for SQLite/D1. The JS string '\\' becomes a single backslash in the SQL. The empty-q path is unchanged.
The query is still parameterized. The escaping only changes how the search term is matched.
The diff touches no UI files.
The diff touches no UI files.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims about the ESCAPE clause, the tests and the behaviour change match the diff. The 'five items' claim is consistent with 3 seeded items plus 2 inserted.
